subject: npm:@bufbuild/protobuf@1.10.1

Lifted by an @elevenlabs/client release whose livekit-client moves to protobuf 2.

subject: npm:next@16.3.8
reason: Needs images.remotePatterns, which apps/web/next.config.ts does not set (the advisory: 'If no images.remotePatterns are configured, your app is not affected'). 16.3.8 is the latest 16.x; take the 16.3 fix when it is published.

subject: npm:next@16.3.8
reason: The MCP endpoint of `next dev` only; production deployments do not serve it. Take the 16.3 fix when it is published.

reason: Needs the Pages Router; apps/web is App Router only (no src/pages). Take the 16.3 fix when it is published.

subject: npm:next@16.3.8
reason: Needs metadata image routes (opengraph-image, twitter-image); apps/web has none. Take the 16.3 fix when it is published.

subject: npm:next@16.3.8

subject: npm:postcss-selector-parser@6.0.10
reason: A build-time CSS tool reading the repository's own stylesheets, never a request. @tailwindcss/typography pins 6.0.10 exactly, its latest release (0.5.20) included, and the fix is 7.1.6, a major it never declared: the npm catch-up (dependency programme, lot 8) could not move it. Lifted by a typography release that moves to 7.x.

subject: pip:fsspec@2025.3.0
reason: The wake-word GPU synthesis toolbox only (scripts/wake-word/requirements-gpu.lock.txt): voxcpm pins datasets 3.6.0, which caps fsspec at 2025.3.0. It runs on the developer's machine, reads local audio and Hugging Face files, and never opens a ReferenceFileSystem; never in production. Lifted when voxcpm accepts a datasets that allows fsspec >= 2026.6.0.

subject: eslint 9
reason: ESLint 10 is still refused by plugins eslint-config-next depends on (three shrink-only ratchets read them; the workaround of vercel/next.js#89764 was rejected). Lifted when eslint-config-next's plugin chain accepts ESLint 10.

subject: python 3.10
reason: The self-host installer's floor (ADR-215): it runs on a bare host's own Python, and Ubuntu 22.04 ships 3.10 with standard support until 2027-06-01. The application itself runs 3.14.

subject: squid 6
reason: Upstream line past support; the demonstrator's egress proxy runs Ubuntu 24.04's package instead (ubuntu/squid:6.6-24.04_edge, squid 6.14-0ubuntu0.24.04.2), which Canonical maintains in main until 2029. The image lags two updates (.3 and .4: CVE-2026-47729, FTP gateway; CVE-2026-50012, cache digests), both unreachable through infrastructure/demo-instance/squid.conf: only CONNECT to five provider hosts on 443 passes, with no cache and no peer. Re-read when Canonical rebuilds the image.

subject: minio/minio:latest
reason: The object store of the development Langfuse profile (docker-compose.dev.yml), outside the dependency programme by decision D2 (Langfuse is stopped; its repair is the first step the day it resumes); the image left Docker Hub.
